digest.component_or_area: plan review criteria routing and gating
propositions: Four zero-finding criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) across ~7,900 agentic runs produced no findings due to missing or ineffective trigger conditions.

Deterministic pre-filter gates using text_all regex conjunctions, file_impact_globs, and file_impact_reason_re patterns must fire before LLM routing to eliminate false negatives while preserving LLM applicability judgment.

Gate skips must be recorded in coverage.routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id and rule name, visible in REVIEW_RESULT sidecars, and threaded through route_criteria and assemble-step callers only (not duplicate-recorded in _project_criteria).

Asserted-capability fires only when both module-ref and capability-verb text_all legs match (conjunction enforced); other criteria fire on text_all match OR any file_impact glob/reason_re match (disjunction).
